target_external_dataset.name: RFMiD (Retinal Fundus Multi-Disease Image Dataset)
target_external_dataset.evaluation_cohort_caution: Support counts represent published Table 3 totals across the entire 3,200 cohort. In challenge distributions where test set labels are withheld, the labelled evaluation cohort is restricted to the train + val partitions (N=2,560). Actual CSV headers, rows, and ground truth availability must be verified on disk for the acquired release prior to computing metrics.

baseline_frozen_reference.core_code_integrity: Identical and committed in src/ across all three runs with zero working-tree modifications.
baseline_frozen_reference.reconciliation_audit: Passed with 100% element-for-element exact confusion matrix match and aggregate summary verification (scripts/audit_baseline_provenance_complete.py).

Diabetic Retinopathy.eligibility: Confirmatory One-vs-Rest AUROC, PR-AUC, Sensitivity, Specificity

Macular Scar.eligibility: Confirmatory One-vs-Rest AUROC, PR-AUC, Sensitivity, Specificity (Flagged: wide bootstrap CIs due to N=27)

Central Serous Chorioretinopathy [Color.eligibility: Confirmatory One-vs-Rest AUROC, Specificity, Sensitivity, PR-AUC

Retinitis Pigmentosa.eligibility: Exploratory Descriptive Analysis Only; Ineligible for standalone statistical validation claims

Myopia.eligibility: One-vs-Rest AUROC (Conditional on Myopic Atrophy MYA), Specificity

Glaucoma.eligibility: Ranking Agreement, AUROC vs ODC; Ineligible for clinical glaucoma diagnosis

Retinal Detachment.eligibility: Direct External Evaluation UNAVAILABLE; Exploratory RT AUROC Only

protocol_governance_rules.multi_label_semantics: Preserved. Each disease evaluated via independent binary One-vs-Rest classification; never forced into 9-class softmax.
protocol_governance_rules.uncertainty_estimation: 95% non-parametric bootstrap confidence intervals (1,000 stratified resamples).
protocol_governance_rules.threshold_policy: Locked to internal validation operating point; zero target-domain threshold optimization.
protocol_governance_rules.leakage_auditing: 3-Pillar scan (SHA-256 cryptographic digest match, pHash DCT Hamming <= 3, DINOv2 cosine > 0.95).
protocol_governance_rules.quarantine: Zero external inference executed; internal test split quarantined.
